summary: Added click-background-to-deselect in both Flow (#flowsvg) and Cloud (#cloudsvg). Each svg gets a one-time click handler (in the zoom-init block): if ev.target===svgEl (bare canvas, not a node) and something is selected, call closeDetail() + re-render to clear the selection outline immediately. Node clicks unaffected (their target is the node element). Verified node --check SYNTAX OK; both handlers served. graph.html static so live on hard-reload.
